basis: Photorespiratory glycolate oxidase; snRNA Mesophyll list 2.1x and M>BS in Fig. 4a, de-etiolating shoot (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). C3 pattern.

Glycine decarboxylase H protein (photorespiration). Portal tags it in situ-validated for leaf mesophyll (Jing et al. 2026 Cell; figure not seen), but in cell-boundary Stereo-seq bins it is 4-9% in Mesophyll and equally high in Upper_epidermis. Kept low until the in situ is seen.
RuBisCO small subunit; paper annotation marker; Mesophyll 1.6x, promoter most accessible in M (snATAC) (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). Light-induced in all green cells; inverts to BS in C4.
LHCII chlorophyll a/b-binding protein; paper annotation marker, Mesophyll 1.1x and also epidermis cl3 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). Weakly specific.
Plastid sigma factor (chloroplast biogenesis, not M-defining); paper annotation marker, Mesophyll 1.6x (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).
Light-harvesting complex gene from PlantscRNAdb; 0.44 of Mesophyll bins vs 0.22-0.30 elsewhere (Jing et al. 2026 Cell). Photosynthesis gene, expressed in all green cells.
Glutaredoxin; Mesophyll DE gene, detected in about 2% of bins (Jing et al. 2026 Cell).
Mesophyll DE gene with low detection in Stereo-seq bins (Jing et al. 2026 Cell).

Oligopeptide transporter; in the ZjPCK::H2B-mTurquoise2 reporter-sorted BS nuclei cluster (6.6x) and atlas BS cl10; also Phloem 3.1x (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). Same-study reporter + atlas, not cross-study.
Amino acid permease; reporter-sorted BS cluster 5.4x and atlas cl10; BS 3.2x = Phloem 3.2x (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). Shared with phloem.
Pht1;8 phosphate transporter; reporter-sorted BS cluster 4.3x and atlas cl10, BS 3.3x (Swift et al. 2024 Nature); fits the transport-type rice BS (Hua et al. 2021 Plant J).
Sulfate transporter; reporter-sorted BS cluster 2.2x and atlas cl10, but Phloem 4.8x > BS 2.7x (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). BS sulfur assimilation (Hua et al. 2021 Plant J).
Cell-wall invertase 1; reporter-sorted BS cluster 3.1x and atlas cl10 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).
Diamine oxidase; reporter-sorted BS cluster 3.5x and atlas cl10 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).
Subtilisin; top atlas BS gene (13.5x), cl10 only, but not in the reporter-sorted BS list (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).
Polygalacturonase; atlas BS 8.9x, Phloem 2.8x; reporter cluster 7 rather than 0 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).

SCHENGEN3-like LRR-RK (Casparian-strip surveillance in Arabidopsis endodermis); atlas cl16 only (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). cl16 label unvalidated; could be another endodermis-like layer of the whole etiolated shoot.
SCHENGEN3 paralog; atlas cl16 only (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). Same caveat as SGN3A.
CASP-like protein; atlas cl16 only (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).

ABCG transporter needed for suberization of the root exodermis (Shiono et al. 2014 Plant J; rice_root.tsv); in leaf, atlas cl16 only (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). Fits a suberized mestome sheath; leaf localization not shown.
Laccase (lignification); atlas cl16 only (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).

Outward-rectifying K+ channel, ortholog of Arabidopsis guard-cell GORK; the sole guard marker of the paper, but not in any cluster top-200 or the Guard list (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). The cl15 "guard" label lacks canonical guard-cell genes.
Oxidosqualene cyclase; top gene of the "guard" cl15 (12.6x), cl15 only (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). cl15 identity unconfirmed (could be another specialised epidermal cell).
Anthocyanin bHLH PURPLE LEAF; "guard" cl15 8.4x (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). cl15 identity unconfirmed.

REVIEW: ZH11 ZH10G23490 -> MSU/RAP by chromosome position only (portal gives no symbol; Oryzabase pairs LOC_Os10g42180 = Os10g0572100 = OsALMT2). Chosen by orthology to Arabidopsis guard-cell ALMT12 (Meyer et al. 2010 Plant J); not detected in Stereo-seq bins (Jing et al. 2026 Cell).
WAX2-like wax aldehyde decarbonylase; paper epidermis annotation marker, Epidermis 3.3x (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).
3-ketoacyl-CoA synthase (cuticular wax); top Epidermis gene 4.0x, cl3 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).
ONION2 KCS (epidermal cuticle; literature recalled in the review, not verified); Epidermis 3.1x (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).
HOTHEAD-like ONION3 (epidermal cuticle; literature not verified); Epidermis 3.5x, also in the rejected "fiber" cl4 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).
BODYGUARD cuticle alpha/beta hydrolase; in "fiber" cl4 and cl15 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). Supports relabelling cl4 as an epidermal subtype.
Chalcone synthase; paper epidermis annotation marker but spread over guard, epidermis and xylem clusters (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).

Non-specific LTP1; Upper_epidermis (adaxial) DE gene with weak contrast in Stereo-seq bins (0.15 vs 0.12) (Jing et al. 2026 Cell); epidermis in situ in the shoot apex (Wang 2025, rice_inflorescence table). Not raised: the leaf contrast is too weak to count as specific.
Stereo-seq Epidermis domain marker, 3-4% of bins, weak contrast (Jing et al. 2026 Cell).

Sucrose/H+ symporter for phloem (re)loading, companion cells (Scofield et al. 2007 J Exp Bot; skill characterized/rice.tsv). Cross-study: phloem cl6 only, 6.2x (Swift et al. 2024 Nature) and Vascular_cell-restricted in cell-boundary Stereo-seq (3-5% vs <=1%) (Jing et al. 2026 Cell). Both atlases label merged phloem/vascular, not companion cells specifically.
FT-INTERACTING PROTEIN 1 (FT export from companion cells; literature, not verified here); paper phloem marker but not in any cluster top-200 or the Phloem list (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).
Callose synthase (sieve-plate callose, family-level); Phloem 11.7x (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).
Callose synthase; Phloem 9.1x (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).
Monosaccharide transporter; Phloem 11.8x (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).
Wall-associated kinase; top Phloem gene 17.6x (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).

REVIEW: ZH11 ZH01G51070 -> MSU/RAP is ambiguous (the symbol ASR6 is used for several chr1/chr4 ASR loci in Oryzabase; LOC_Os01g73250/Os01g0963600 is one candidate, Os01g0959200 another). Stereo-seq Phloem domain marker, Vascular_cell 0.26 vs <=0.13 (Jing et al. 2026 Cell).
ABCG cytokinin exporter, promoter-GUS in vascular tissue (Zhao et al. 2019 J Exp Bot); listed as a leaf Phloem marker but not detected in Stereo-seq bins (Jing et al. 2026 Cell).
Euonymus-type lectin, vascular tissue specificity in the literature (Lambin et al. 2020 Front Plant Sci); Vascular_cell-enriched in Stereo-seq bins (0.21 vs 0.14) (Jing et al. 2026 Cell).

Uncharacterized DE gene with the strongest Vascular_cell enrichment in cell-boundary Stereo-seq bins (0.40 vs <=0.18; 0.26 vs <=0.21) (Jing et al. 2026 Cell). Vascular_cell merges xylem, phloem and probably bundle/mestome sheath.

Silicon channel NIP2;2, xylem parenchyma in the literature (Yamaji et al. 2015 PNAS, node); in leaf data, BS 3.7x and Phloem 1.9x (Swift et al. 2024 Nature, BS cluster may include vascular parenchyma) and <=4% of Stereo-seq bins (Jing et al. 2026 Cell). Leaf localization not verified here; cell types disagree, so not raised.

Papain-like xylem cysteine protease (TE autolysis family); paper xylem annotation marker, cl12 only, 3.9x (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). Raised low->medium: metaxylem/central-xylem in situ in roots (Liu 2021, Wang 2021; rice_root.tsv). Not the Os05g0108600 "XCP2" of Zhang 2021.
Xylem cysteine protease paralog; Xylem 5.7x, cl12 and cl16 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). Symbols swap between papers; compare by ID.

Secondary-wall cellulose synthase, brittle culm mutant (Tanaka et al. 2003 Plant Physiol); Xylem 2.0x but also SCW sclerenchyma cl9 and cl16 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature); root xylem in situ (Zhang 2021, rice_root.tsv). Not raised: not cluster-specific in leaf, marks all SCW cells.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (Tanaka et al. 2003 Plant Physiol); Xylem 2.4x, also cl9 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). Marks all SCW cells incl. sclerenchyma.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (Tanaka et al. 2003 Plant Physiol); Xylem 2.4x, also cl9 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). Marks all SCW cells incl. sclerenchyma.
COBRA-like BRITTLE CULM1, needed for secondary walls of sclerenchyma (Li et al. 2003 Plant Cell); only in the unlabeled SCW cluster cl9 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).
SCARECROW2 GRAS factor of the grass stomatal lineage (literature, not verified here); in the proliferating "epidermis" cl7 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature).
Replication-licensing helicase subunit; top gene of the S-phase "epidermis" cl7 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature). Proliferation flag, not an identity marker.
